_noteE: E (Powder Keg) investigated loop 219 (flagged missingSlots by the audit). Two champion-facing bonus-damage DataValues exist -- GangplankE's own 'BonusDamageToChampions' (55-175) and GangplankESpellPassive's 'ChampionBonusDamage' (80,80,105,130,155,180,205) -- but NEITHER is referenced by any mSpellCalculations entry (E's own calcs are FinalSlowAmount/BarrelDecayTime only; GangplankEBarrelFuseMissile has no DataValues/calcs at all), and critically there is no discoverable BASE keg-explosion damage number anywhere in this bin at all -- a keg's detonation damage appears to be native/scripted rather than a data-driven GameCalculation. Curating only the champion bonus term without the (unlocatable) base would understate the real hit by an unknown, likely dominant amount, and it's unclear whether BonusDamageToChampions and ChampionBonusDamage are the same mechanic read twice or two distinct triggers (direct keg explosion vs. igniting an already-placed keg) -- both genuinely ambiguous from bin structure alone. Left uncurated rather than ship a partial/misleading number (M26 P2); flagging here so this is a documented decision, not an oversight. M26 stage-4 recheck: wiki verbatim confirms the omission stands -- 'Enemies caught in an explosion are dealt the triggering attack's damage' (the base term IS the detonating basic attack/Q, already counted as that node's own damage in a combo; curating it here would double-count), the champion bonus (BonusDamageToChampions rank1-5 = 75/95/115/135/155, matches wiki '75 / 95 / 115 / 135 / 155', curation_evidence/Gangplank.json) fires only on that player-sequenced attack-detonation (E cast alone deals zero), and 'If an enemy destroys it, it is safely defused'. No schema shape represents 'inherit the triggering attack's damage' without double-counting; omission stands.
